'''Savar''' ({{lang-bn|সাভার}}) is a city in central Bangladesh, located in the [[Dhaka District]] in the [[Dhaka Division|division of Dhaka]]. It is the closest city from [[Dhaka]]. It is also a part of the [[Greater Dhaka]] conurbation which forms the [[Greater Dhaka|Dhaka megacity]]. About 296,851 people live here which makes this city the 2nd largest in the district and [[List of cities and towns in Bangladesh|11th largest]] city in Bangladesh.<ref name="4.1.31 Savar" />

==Geography==
Savar city is located at {{coord|23.85|90.26|type:city_region:BD}} in the central region of [[Bangladesh]].<ref name="4.1.31 Savar" />

==Demographics==
According to the [[2011 Bangladesh census]] the total population of the city was 296,851, of which 132,692 are [[male]]s and 124,062 are [[female]]s with a density of {{convert|11,300|pd/km2}}. The number of total households in the city is 60,290.<ref name="4.1.31 Savar" />

==Administration==
Savar is governed by a [[Paurashava]] named Savar municipality which consists of 9 [[Wards of Bangladesh|wards]] and 56 [[Mahalla (Bangladesh)|mahallas]], which occupies an area of {{cvt|14.08|km2}}.<ref name="4.1.31 Savar" />
